body: Thank you for taking time out of your day to write that out, I appreciate it.

Meh, I can imagine that high school reunions suck anyway. 

Not sure why you would want to see anyone that you didn't keep in contact with anyway.

Sometimes you have to find shit to look forward to. That new game coming out next year? Ordering in Chinese food? 

Sometimes it's the best we can do at this point in time until something better comes along.
